old_caption: The video captures a serene scene of four individuals enjoying a natural waterfall in a lush, green forest setting. The waterfall cascades down a rocky slope into a calm pool below, surrounded by dense foliage and trees. The first individual is seen standing on the left side of the frame, observing the others. The second person is sitting on a wooden board at the top of the waterfall, remaining stationary. The third individual stands further up the slope, also observing the activity. The fourth person is positioned further up the slope, also observing the activity. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and recreational, highlighting the beauty of nature and the simple pleasure of interacting with it.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene scene of four individuals enjoying a natural waterfall in a lush, green forest setting. The waterfall cascades down a rocky slope into a calm pool below, surrounded by dense foliage and trees. The first individual is seen standing on the left side of the frame, observing the others. The second person is sitting on a wooden board at the top of the waterfall, preparing to slide down. The third individual stands near the middle of the waterfall, watching the process unfold. The fourth person is positioned further up the slope, also observing the activity. As the video progresses, the person on the wooden board slides down the waterfall, creating a splash upon landing in the pool. The other three individuals remain stationary, continuing to watch the action. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and recreational, highlighting the beauty of nature and the simple pleasure of interacting with it.
caption: The video captures a small jungle waterfall tumbling over a sloping rock ledge into a murky green-brown pool, framed by dense tropical foliage. Four shirtless men in swim trunks occupy the wet rock face. One stands at the far-left edge, another perches on the upper ledge behind a third who sits with his legs extended down the cascade. A fourth man in patterned shorts stands mid-ledge facing the camera. Whitewater continuously rushes over the dark stone and the pool surface keeps churning with shifting foam. The seated man holds his position, making only small weight adjustments as the water flows around him. The two standing men on the left remain largely still, watching the scene. The mid-ledge man gradually shifts his footing and takes slow, careful steps downward along the slick rock toward the pool. Over the clip the framing drifts slightly rightward, cropping the far-left man at the edge while revealing more of the right bank and the open water.

infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.

and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
